name: LudingMat
description: Material for simple Luding`s model of contact [Luding2008]_ ,[Singh2013]_ .

attributes.name: kp
attributes.description: Slope of unloading and reloading limit elastic branch

attributes.name: kc
attributes.description: Slope of irreversible, tensile adhesive branch

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Numeric id of this material; is non-negative only if this Material is shared (i.e. in O.materials), -1 otherwise. This value is set automatically when the material is inserted to the simulation via O.materials.append. (This id was necessary since before boost::serialization was used, shared pointers were not tracked properly; it might disappear in the future)

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual identifier for this material; can be used for shared materials lookup in MaterialContainer.

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.
